english.title: Pay candidate's election expenses other than through agent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of illegal practice in that you made a payment of **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..) in respect of election expenses incurred by or on behalf of

(A)_[a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..),]_
(B)_[yourself as a candidate]_

at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..),other than by or through

(C)_[the candidate's]_
(D)_[your]_

election agent
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 73(6) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
made a payment in respect of election expenses incurred
by or on behalf of a candidate at an election
other than by or through the candidate's election agent

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
